aiResearchSummary.text: Agility Robotics is researching dynamically stable mobile robots, focusing on escalating hazard response for legged platforms and methods for improving stability in a legged robot. Mechanical work centers on cycloid gear assembly with partial contact, cycloid gear assembly with alternating contact between transfer members, strain-wave gear assembly having circumferentially spaced apart bridge circuits, threadable cycloid actuator, torque protection for strain wave drives, and a robot joint with wire routing for enhanced durability.
